적 기물 두 개에 심판을 지정합니다. 각 대상이 지정 이후 2킬을 하면: Mark two enemy pieces for judgment. Each dies when its heart outweighs the feather after 2 kills since being marked.
두 대상의 킬 수는 각각 계산합니다. 킹은 제외하며 지정 이전의 킬은 세: Track each target separately. Kings are excluded; earlier kills do not count. Judgment bypasses extra lives.
Experimental rules: Spend one action to mark two enemy non-king pieces. Each tracks ordinary captures, ballista kills, and duel victories after marking. Shield hits and canceled attacks do not count. After its second kill resolves, the target dies, bypassing extra lives and status immunity. Death clears the mark; normal revival rules apply.

Mark the enemy rook and knight. Each counts only kills made after marking.
Both enemies receive the heart-and-feather judgment mark.
The rook makes its first kill: 1/2. The knight remains at 0/2.
The judgment marks and kill counts remain through the opponent’s turn.
The rook completes its second kill. The scales tip, and judgment kills the rook too.
체크 의무가 없고 킹도 포획됩니다. 수송 중인 폰은 생존, 승격한 기물은: No check obligation; kings can be captured. Transported pawns count as alive, but promoted pieces do not count as pawns. You lose immediately with no pawns left.
일반 포획 3회마다 같은 기물로 추가 이동 1회를 얻습니다. 추가 이동: Every 3 ordinary captures grant one extra move with the same piece. Abilities are unavailable during the bonus move; wait if no move is possible.
실제 사망한 적 기물 3개를 선택합니다. 수송·결투 중인 기물은 대상이: Choose 3 actually dead enemy pieces. Transported pieces and duel participants are excluded. Unavailable with fewer than 3 targets.
첫 공격을 받으면 폰의 목숨만 소모하고 공격자와 폰 모두 제자리에 남습니: The first attack consumes a pawn's extra life. Attacker and pawn stay in place, and the attacker's turn ends. Instant-death traps ignore extra lives.
모든 나이트가 첫 턴부터 사용 가능하고 사용 후 내 5번째 턴에 재사용합: All knights can use this from the first turn and reuse it on your 5th turn after use. All pieces on the 8 surrounding squares, friend or foe, cannot move or attack for 3 of their own turns.
선택한 능력이 실제 대전에 적용됩니다. 12표법은 준비 중이며, 자세한: Selected abilities apply in battle. The Twelve Tables are in development. See the cards and battle help for detailed rules.
그리스·이집트·로마의 선택한 능력이 적용됩니다. 12표법만 준비 중이며: Selected Greek, Egyptian, and Roman abilities apply. Only the Twelve Tables are in development. See the cards for detailed rules.
아군을 잡은 적을 다음 내 턴에 처치하면, 처치한 기물의 스킬 쿨타임이: Recapture an enemy that took an ally on your next turn to reduce the capturing piece’s skill cooldown by 1 turn.
The enemy receives a question mark. Cooldown reductions cannot be saved.
임시 규칙: 아군을 실제로 처치한 적에게 질문 표식을 부여합니다. 바로: Experimental rules: Enemies that kill an ally receive a question mark. Kill that enemy on your very next turn to reduce the killer’s remaining piece-skill cooldown by 1 turn. Applies to ordinary captures, ballista kills, and duel victories, not shield hits. Cooldowns cannot fall below zero and reductions cannot be banked.
Counterattack with a knight whose skill is on cooldown.
The enemy rook that captures your pawn receives a question mark.
바로 다음 내 턴에 나이트로 되잡으면 남은 스킬 쿨타임이 1턴 줄어듭니다: Recapture with the knight on your next turn to reduce its remaining skill cooldown by 1 turn.
